tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Use this when a person asks where The Wellness is, or which cities it serves. Returns every city, London, Dubai, Beverly Hills, New York, Miami, Singapore, Hong Kong, Paris, Monaco, San Francisco, Tokyo, Sydney, Milan, Riyadh and Jeddah, with its country, currency, whether it is booked online or by

tools.name: find_care
tools.description: Use this when a person wants private healthcare from The Wellness and has not named a blood test, a scan or a specialist. It covers a private GP in person, by video or by phone, a doctor at a home or hotel, health assessments, IV therapy, longevity, psychiatry and ADHD, dermatology, dentistry and ae

tools.name: find_blood_tests
tools.description: Use this when a person wants a private blood test or a named marker such as cholesterol, thyroid, hormones, vitamin D, HbA1c or a full health panel. Returns each panel with the markers it measures, the fee, where the sample is taken and when results arrive. Does not interpret results.

tools.name: find_scans
tools.description: Use this when a person wants a private MRI, CT, ultrasound, X-ray, DEXA, echocardiogram, mammogram, coronary calcium score or full-body MRI. Returns each scan with its fee, its length and when the report arrives. A scan may need a referral, which the clinic arranges. Does not read images or reports.

tools.name: find_specialists
tools.description: Use this when a person wants to see a named doctor or a kind of specialist, such as a cardiologist, a dermatologist, a gynaecologist or a psychiatrist, or names a condition such as knee pain or menopause. Search by specialty, condition, name, city or language spoken. Returns each doctor with their r

tools.name: get_times
tools.description: Use this when a person has chosen a service or a doctor and wants to see times. Returns times on the city's own clock. In London these are times that can be requested now. In other cities the team confirms the time within the hour. No time is held by this call.

tools.name: check_cover
tools.description: Use this when a person asks whether their health insurance can be used at The Wellness, or wants a doctor their insurer recognises. Takes the insurer's name only. Returns whether the clinic is recognised by that insurer, what the person needs to hand and whether authorisation is needed first. Never

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Use this when the person wants the full detail of one service they have found with find_care, find_blood_tests or find_scans. Pass its key, and the city outside London. Returns what is included, the fee as the checkout or the city page shows it, the length, the doctors with their register links, the

tools.name: hold_time
tools.description: Use this when a person has picked a time and wants to go ahead. Creates a reference and, where the diary allows it, holds the time for ten minutes. Takes no personal details. Returns a link the person opens to enter their details, confirm and pay. Nothing is booked or charged by this call.

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Use this after hold_time, when the person says to book it. Shows the booking for the person to confirm on The Wellness page. The person confirms and pays there. This call never charges anything and never takes card details.

tools.name: request_care
tools.description: Use this when a person wants care in a city where the team arranges the appointment, or wants something that is not on a list, such as a second opinion, a home visit abroad or help arranging several appointments. The first call returns a summary to show the person. The second, with the code, sends t

tools.name: get_booking
tools.description: Use this when a person gives a booking reference and asks where it stands. Returns the service, the city, the time and each step in words, the current one marked. A change is made with change_booking.

tools.name: change_booking
tools.description: Use this when a person gives a booking reference and wants to move it to a new day or time. The move is a request the person confirms on The Wellness page. Returns the link for it. To cancel, use cancel_booking.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Use this when a person gives a booking reference and wants to cancel it. The first call returns a summary to show the person and a code, and changes nothing. Call again with the code only when they agree. A booking not yet paid is cancelled at once; a paid one goes to the team, who confirm it with t

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search The Boutique, the online shop of The Wellness (a doctor-led clinic and technology company), with supplements and health technology chosen by its doctors. Returns live prices in GBP and the product page URL to buy. UK delivery only; standard delivery is included.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get one Boutique product by its URL slug, id or full product URL. Returns the live price, description, highlights, images, identifiers, delivery options and the page to buy it.

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: The price of a Wellness service, from the site's price list, the one source of truth. Call it before stating any figure. A service not on the list has no price until a colleague confirms it. Quote the price exactly as returned, never offer a discount, and never mention what a partner charges us.

tools.name: create_basket
tools.description: Build a Boutique basket for the person and get the checkout link. Pass the products from search_products (id or slug) with quantities, and subscribe: true for subscribe-and-save where the person wants it. Returns a summary to read back to the person, each line at the price checkout charges, anything

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_services" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_service" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "One service at The Wellness by its key from search_services. In London it returns what the service is and what is included, the fee in GBP as the checkout charges it, the duration, the clinic, the named doctors for that service with their published credentials and GMC register links, the Care Qualit" → after: "Use this when the person wants the full detail of one service they have found with find_care, find_blood_tests or find_scans. Pass its key, and the city outside London. Returns what is included, the fee as the checkout or the city page shows it, the length, the doctors with their register links, the"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
